installation: the release wheel in an environment outside the checkout
title: Independent solver at matched accuracy: TorchFDTD and Meep against a converged RCWA reference, accuracy-versus-cost curves

fixture.reference: TORCWA 101 Fourier orders, checked against 51 (at most 1e-4)

meep.device: i7-12700, 4 MPI ranks, torchfdtd-bench WSL distribution

material_sampling.staircase: both solvers; Meep eps_averaging off; the whole structure is shifted by half a cell in x and y at a mesh where an edge would fall on a node
material_sampling.smoothed: Meep default subpixel averaging; TorchFDTD experimental subpixel interfaces; no shift

precision: TorchFDTD float32 and float64; Meep double
backend: cuda for TorchFDTD, cpu for Meep

acceptance.records: every point with median and range of three runs
acceptance.curves: accuracy-versus-cost curves of both solvers rendered from the record
acceptance.matched_cost: cost to reach errors 0.01, 0.005 and 0.002 by log-log interpolation for each solver and each sampling series
acceptance.separation: equal-cell-count and equal-error comparisons reported separately
acceptance.hardware: the record states CPU against GPU hardware and draws no algorithmic conclusion from it
